summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Kashmir Super Deluxe landing page. All backend endpoints (POST/GET /api/leads, validation, GET /api/) pass (5/5 pytest). Frontend renders at both '/' (bug fix verified) and '/kashmir-super-deluxe' with data-testid='kashmir-landing-page' present and 'Explore Kashmir' hero visible. All hero and floating CTAs (WhatsApp/Call) have correct hrefs to +917006186445. Lead form end-to-end works: filled Name/Phone, selected Guests=3-5, Month=June, submit returned 200 with lead JSON containing id, and success toast 'Request received! Connecting you now…' appeared.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend send_lead_notification uses asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget which is fine but any exception will be logged only; acceptable for MVP.
GET /api/leads has no pagination limit param (hardcoded 1000); acceptable for MVP but consider ?limit/offset later.
Lead phone validation is only whitespace check — consider regex for E.164 formatting later.
test_credentials: N/A - public landing page, no auth
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test leads with TEST_ prefix (TEST_John Doe and TEST_UI User) via API and UI submit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified. Root path '/' now correctly renders the landing page (bug fix confirmed). Lenis smooth scroll must be destroyed before programmatic scroll in Playwright — window.__lenis.destroy() worked. Test leads with prefix TEST_ remain in MongoDB.
rca of the issue: Original bug: preview blank because '/' served CRA default. Fix: Added Route path='/' rendering <KashmirSuperDeluxe/> in App.js alongside '/kashmir-super-deluxe'. Verified working.
